description: This file defines a utility class 'BCryptHelper' that provides methods for parsing BCrypt password hashes, specifically to extract the number of hashing iterations used. It contains regex patterns for matching BCrypt hashes and validates the version used.

classes.name: BCryptHelper
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to parse and validate BCrypt hashes.

methods.name: getIterations
methods.description: Extracts the number of iterations from a BCrypt hash string, ensuring it uses version 2a.
